activate.when: The user activates the icon button (pointer click, Enter or Space) while it is neither disabled nor loading.

rules: The container is a square of boxSize by boxSize; it neither shrinks nor stretches in a flexible layout. The icon part holds exactly one icon, centered in the container by its box at iconSize, in the resolved content color; the host's iconSize replaces the icon's own size option.

label is required and non-empty; it is the accessible name and is never shown as visible text. The icon is decorative and hidden from assistive technology. Showing label on hover or focus is the job of a tooltip composed by the integration, not of the icon button.
The interaction target meets minTarget in both dimensions without enlarging the visible container; the visible size is unchanged by density, like Button heights at each density.
Resolve the interaction state in this order: disabled, loading, pressed, hover, default. Focus is an independent axis.
Emit activate only when neither disabled nor loading; a disabled or loading icon button never navigates.
When href is set and the icon button is not disabled, it navigates to href as a link; otherwise it is a button. Appearance and states are identical in both roles.
Disabled removes the icon button from sequential focus; loading keeps it focusable, exposes a busy state and keeps label as the accessible name.

While loading, loadingIndicator replaces the icon at the same place and size, so the container does not change; when loading and disabled are both true, interaction resolves to disabled and loadingIndicator stays visible in the resolved content color.
Draw border only for the outline appearance, inside the container; it never changes the outer dimensions.

When focus is true and was reached by keyboard, draw a focus indicator of focusWidth in focusColor at focusOffset outside the container, with corners of focusRadius so that it stays concentric with the container.

Color changes between interaction states transition over motionDuration with easingStandard; no transition when reduced motion is requested. The loadingIndicator animation is slowed or stopped under reduced motion.

Visual treatments, colors, corner radius and focus indicator are those of Button for the same intent, appearance and size, so that an icon button sits beside a Button of the same size at the same height.
In forced-colors mode the container keeps a visible boundary, the icon is drawn in the system button text color and the focus indicator stays visible.
